keyPoints: Prakriti ne humein anmol khazane diye hain — khanij, chattanen, jivashm indhan, saaf paani, upjaoo mitti aur hare-bhare jungle; ye sab hamare jeevan ka aadhar hain.
Chattanen (rocks) khanijon se banti hain; sangmarmar aur granite imaraton me, jabki ret aur bajri sadak-nirman me kaam aate hain.
Loha, taamba, aluminium, sona aur chandi jaise khanij dharti ke andar se khodkar nikale jaate hain aur hamare rozmarra ke saaman me istemal hote hain.
Koyla aur petroleum jivashm indhan hain — karodon saal purane jeevon ke avasheshon se bane; ek baar khatm ho gaye to dobara nahi milenge.
Jungle humein lakdi, aushadhiya paudhe, saaf hawa aur barish dete hain; andhadhundh ped katna prakriti ka seedha nuksan hai.
Paani sabse keemti khazana hai — dharti par peene yogya paani bahut kam hai, isiliye use bachana har nagrik ka kartavya hai.
Aam galti: prakritik sansadhanon ko aseemit samajhna; koyla-petroleum samapt hone wale hain, inhe soch-samajhkar kharch karo aur saur-pawan urja apnao.

title: Prakriti ke Khazane
